title: Rerun Safety: red on main for at least ten consecutive nights, and it dies in `pass 1` — so the rerun property it guards has never been measured
body:
Filed by the `domain:cli` execution PM seat (#6024), found on the hourly patrol's unlock scan while confirming a DIFFERENT nightly (#17633, `Nightly Tiers`, now green and closed). ⛔ Lane and kind only — ⛔ priority is triage's carrier and is deliberately not set here.

## The guard has been dead for at least ten nights, and it dies before it can measure its own property

`Rerun Safety` (workflow `323746634`, `.github/workflows/rerun-safety-nightly.yml`) runs one job — **`Full suite twice in one working tree`** — whose point is to catch tests that pass once and fail on a second run in the same tree.

Measured on `main`, the newest **10** runs returned by the workflow-scoped API:

| run | conclusion | created |
|---|---|---|
| 35180366612 | `failure` | 2026-09-17T04:01:46Z |
| 35054015163 | `failure` | 2026-09-16T04:01:40Z |
| 34927232779 | `failure` | 2026-09-15T04:01:56Z |
| 34804578889 | `failure` | 2026-09-14T04:01:52Z |
| 34736903922 | `failure` | 2026-09-13T04:01:36Z |
| 34671914208 | `failure` | 2026-09-12T04:01:42Z |
| 34560644921 | `failure` | 2026-09-11T04:01:48Z |
| 34435568710 | `failure` | 2026-09-10T04:01:46Z |
| 34309384050 | `failure` | 2026-09-09T04:02:00Z |
| 34185532041 | `failure` | 2026-09-08T04:01:54Z |

⛔ The streak is **at least** 10 — the page did not contain a non-failure, so the true length may be longer; ⛔ not measured beyond that page.

⭐ **The failing step is `Test suite — pass 1`.** ⇒ the job never reaches pass 2, so the rerun-safety property — the only thing this workflow exists to measure — **has not been measured on `main` for at least ten nights**. Its red is indistinguishable from the red it exists to report.

## The cause, from the newest run's log

One test file, three tests, all three `Error: Test timed out in 5000ms`:

```
FAIL integration packages/cli/test/published-entry-node-env-source-reroute.test.ts
  > #12271 - the published entry does not reroute to src/ on an ambient NODE_ENV
      > resolves commands from dist/ under an ambient NODE_ENV=development   (:158)
      > resolves commands from dist/ under an ambient NODE_ENV=test          (:165)
      > NODE_ENV=production stays green, the leg that was never broken       (:172)

Test Files  1 failed | 257 passed (258)
     Tests  3 failed | 3419 passed (3422)
  Duration  773.02s     — and the whole turbo run: Time 39m50.01s
```

⭐ **The tell is the third one.** That leg is the file's own deliberate CONTROL — its name says it is *"the leg that was never broken"* — and it times out too. ⇒ all three legs fail identically regardless of the `NODE_ENV` they set, which is the signature of the **spawn harness under load**, ⛔ not of the `NODE_ENV` rerouting the file is about. `runPublishedEntry` spawns a published entry against a default 5s vitest timeout, inside a workflow that deliberately runs the whole suite twice on one machine.

## Why it matters beyond one flaky file

1. ⛔ A ratchet that cannot complete pass 1 proves nothing about pass 2. Ten nights of red look like "rerun safety is failing" and actually mean "rerun safety is unmeasured".
2. ⚠️ **It is easy to misread as another card's red.** Three workflows in this repo carry a nightly name and they are NOT the same colour: `Nightly Tiers` (`351964220`) is **green** as of 2026-09-17T05:57Z; `Spec Coverage` (`321429522`) is green; this one is red. A seat grepping "nightly" would have kept #17633 open on this workflow's red.

## ⛔ Not established

- ⛔ Whether every one of the ten failures has this same cause — only the newest run's log was read.
- ⛔ Whether the same file times out outside this workflow (in the ordinary CI suite or locally). If it is green there, the load hypothesis strengthens; ⛔ that comparison was not run.
- ⛔ The remedy. Raising a timeout, making the spawn cheaper, or tiering the file out of the doubled run are all candidates and this card rules on none of them — ⛔ and "raise the timeout until it passes" is exactly the move that would hide a real rerun failure later.

## Re-check

```
GET /repos/objectstack-ai/objectstack/actions/workflows/323746634/runs?branch=main&per_page=10
GET /repos/objectstack-ai/objectstack/actions/runs/<newest>/jobs      -> step "Test suite — pass 1"
```
